description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android wearable flashlight app, managing UI fragments and page navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the flashlight app's UI and fragment navigation.

classes.name: LightFragmentAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing fragments within the ViewPager.

classes.name: WhiteLightFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the white light view.

classes.name: PartyLightFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the party light view with cycling controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up ViewPager and fragments, and manages page change events.

methods.name: addFragment
methods.description: Adds a fragment to the adapter and updates the ViewPager.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for each fragment.

methods.name: startCycling
methods.description: Starts the cycling effect in PartyLightView.

methods.name: stopCycling
methods.description: Stops the cycling effect in PartyLightView.
